scope: Derived source-level comparison manifest, not an upstream Vulkan Profiles JSON or certification. Supported means a reported query value only.

sources.access_note: Single small source file read in memory via mirror; no Mesa source archive/tree was downloaded.

normalization.alternatives: Each array in upstream capabilities is OR across complete AND capability blocks.
normalization.optional_blocks: Preserved under VP_ZINK_gl46_optimal as advisory groups, never required for GL2.1.
normalization.extensions: Formal profiles retain literal advertised extension names/spec versions; only runtime checks explicitly permit core promotions.
normalization.limits: max-prefixed numeric minima use >=; boolean strictLines uses equality; bit arrays require all named bits.
normalization.manual_unknowns: Optional subgroupSize semantics not guessed; unsupported/unqueried fields and unimplemented behavior remain unknown.
